text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that teaches computers to "see" and understand the world through images and videos. One of its main tasks is image recognition, where the computer identifies what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. A more advanced task is object detection, which not only finds objects but also shows their exact location in the image. This technology is used everywhere, from unlocking your phone with your face to helping doctors analyze medical scans. Perhaps the most exciting application is in self-driving cars, where computer vision helps vehicles recognize traffic lights, pedestrians, and other cars to drive safely.
